pages.text: By mantikafasi, from a late-game base. Label names here are lowercase and use underscores.
$(l)mainpassive$(): priority list that keeps a drawer controller stocked. Its astralsorchery checks are a typo and always pass. 10 labels.
$(l)cleanroom$(): keeps a buffer stocked with AE2 printed circuits. 5 labels.
$(l)definer$(): sends each fluid from a Storage Exposer to its own tank. 121 labels.
$(l)defineremptyall$(): empties those same tanks back out. 121 labels.
$(l)soulaccumilator$(): items and fluids for soul binder and rock snot setups. 8 labels.
$(l)uncorrupted_library$(): passes redstone when a buffer holds 128k of each demon crystal. Delete its last redstone pair or it always passes. 3 labels.
$(l)ludi_output_keep_1_in_each_slot$(): keeps 1 item in each of 32 output slots, the rest goes to drawers. 2 labels.
